title: The proof tier after example 290's second round of engine changes, VF-018's three tests apart: every other ignored Rust test in release, none hidden by a failure
description: Runs the proof tier's command with cargo's --no-fail-fast and without the three heap tests VF-018 tracks (JBMC's timeouts, which no change here touches), as the jobs after examples 287 to 290 did. The change behind it is in the own checker (lib/src/bmc), which nearly every proof-tier test runs: Arrays.copyOf of an array of references is modelled where it was refused for its array result; new ConcurrentHashMap() and new ConcurrentHashMap(int) make an object with no content where each was a gap; a model of java.util.ArrayList is run only for a check that asks for it (--model), so the class is as it was for every test of the tier; a regression check made as a property of the pair of versions answers the previous version's Class.forName and getName on its own class path, and takes --observed-initializer and --model. The tests of what changed (the unit tests, claims, values, conformance, pairing, object_strings, loops, value_parameters) pass inline.
expected: exits 0: every proof-tier test but VF-018's three passes

resources.notes: the same job after example 290's first round took about 35 minutes

steps.name: proof tier, no fail fast, VF-018's three skipped
steps.run: JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 JVMCONTRACT_HEAP_TIME_LIMIT=1800 JVMCONTRACT_TEST_TIER=proof TEST_COST=proof cargo test --manifest-path lib/Cargo.toml --release --no-fail-fast -- --ignored --test-threads 4 --skip the_output_relations_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm --skip the_other_object_reads_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm --skip the_parameter_reads_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm
